name: The Assistant
source:
The Assistant is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel that combines adventure, suspense, action and sex. You play as a young man who gets a new job as a personal assistant for a wealthy family. You will meet the family members and see how your entire life changes because of this new job. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461430/The_Assistant_Season_1/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《助理》是一部选择驱动的成人视觉小说，融合了冒险、悬疑、动作和性爱。你扮演一个年轻人，他找到了一份新工作，为一个富裕的家庭担任私人助理。你将与家人见面，并看到你的整个生活如何因这份新工作而改变。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461430/The_Assistant_Season_1/]Steam[/url]]
